members.name: O1A.SCALED

members.note: Vector of numbers/NILs with at least one number -> each present value divided by the largest present value, NILs kept

members.name: R3A.SCALED

members.name: E2A.SCALED
members.body: 'EV' BIND EV E2A.PRESENT 'EP' BIND EV EP EP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV

members.name: S0A.SCALED
members.body: 'CV' BIND CV S0A.PRESENT 'CP' BIND CP CP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'MX' BIND CV [ 'SE' BIND NIL 0 SE SE NIL? SELECT MX DIV SE NIL? SELECT ] MAP
members.note: readings with NILs -> each present reading over the largest present, NIL kept

members.name: S0D.SCALED
members.body: 'V' BIND V S0D.PRESENT 'P' BIND P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND V [ 'X' BIND NIL 0 X X NIL? SELECT M DIV X NIL? SELECT ] MAP
members.note: each present element divided by the largest present element; NILs stay NIL

members.note: order Record -> qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

members.note: non-empty Vector -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

members.body: E2A.MISSING 'EM' BIND FALSE 1 COLLECT EM -1 DROP CONCAT NOT EM AND [ ] FILTER LENGTH
members.note: V with NILs -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

members.name: Z3B.GAPS
members.body: X3.NIFULO 'ZM' BIND ZM 0 1 COLLECT ZM -1 DROP CONCAT SUB 0 MAX 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: number of runs of consecutive NILs in a Vector

members.name: Z3B.LONGGAP
members.body: X3.NIFULO 0 [ 'ZE' BIND 1 ADD ZE MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: length of the longest run of consecutive NILs

members.body: X3.NIFULO 'Z3D.GI' BIND Z3D.GI [ 0 ] Z3D.GI -1 DROP CONCAT SUB 0 MAX 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Vector with NILs -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

members.name: G0D.GAPS
members.body: [ 'GE' BIND 1 0 GE NIL? SELECT ] MAP G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of the runs of consecutive NILs (each run a Vector of 1s)

members.name: E1D.GAPS
members.body: E1D.MISSING G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of the maximal runs of NILs, each as a Vector of 1s (its length is the gap length)

members.name: E2D.GAPS
members.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 'T' BIND 1 0 T SELECT G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of its maximal runs of NIL lanes, each run a Vector of 1s (one per missing lane)

members.name: S0A.GAPS
members.body: [ 'GE' BIND 'x' 'o' GE NIL? SELECT ] MAP JOIN 'o' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
members.note: readings with NILs -> one String of x's per run of missing readings

members.name: U1D.GAPS
members.body: U1D.NILMASK G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of its runs of consecutive NILs, each run a Vector of 1s (LENGTH gives the gap length)

members.body: [ NIL? ] MAP [ 'MQ' BIND 1 0 MQ SELECT ] MAP G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER

members.name: U3C.DELTAS
members.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP
members.note: Bracket String -> Vector with +1 for each opening bracket and -1 for each closing bracket, per character.

members.name: R2B.MAJ
members.body: 'R2B.JV' BIND R2B.JV TALLY 'R2B.JT' BIND R2B.JT R1A.ARGMAX 'R2B.JK' BIND R2B.JK 1 COLLECT 0 1 R2B.JT R2B.JK GET 2 MUL R2B.JV LENGTH GT SELECT GET

members.name: R1D.USTACKS
members.body: 'R1D.UV' BIND '#' 1 COLLECT R1D.UV CHARS '#' [ R1D.USTEP ] SCAN CONCAT
members.note: bracket String -> Vector of reduction stacks after each prefix, the empty prefix ('#') first; a prefix is balanced exactly when its stack is '#'

members.name: R1B.BSTATES
members.body: G0A.BSCAN 'BS' BIND '#' 1 COLLECT BS CONCAT
members.note: bracket String -> Vector of matching stacks, '#' for the empty prefix first (one more lane than characters)

members.name: R2B.BSIGN
members.body: 'R2B.SC' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD R2B.SC GET
members.note: Bracket char -> 1 for an opener, -1 for a closer.

members.name: R2A.BVAL
members.body: 'R2A.BC' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD R2A.BC GET
members.note: bracket char -> 1 for an opener, -1 for a closer

members.name: R1D.CSTEP
members.body: 'R1D.CX' BIND R1D.CX 2 DIV 'R1D.CH' BIND R1D.CH R1D.CX 3 MUL 1 ADD R1D.CH FLOOR R1D.CH EQ SELECT 1 R1D.CX 1 EQ NOT SELECT
members.note: positive integer -> its Collatz successor (even halves, odd becomes 3n+1), with 1 staying 1

members.name: Z2B.CSTEP
members.body: 'Z2B.CX' BIND 1 Z2B.CX 2 DIV Z2B.CX 3 MUL 1 ADD Z2B.CX Z2B.CX 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL EQ SELECT Z2B.CX 1 EQ SELECT
members.note: one Collatz step, 1 stays 1

members.name: R2A.CSTEP
members.body: 'R2A.CI' BIND 'R2A.CA' BIND R2A.CA 0 GET 'R2A.CV' BIND R2A.CV 2 DIV 'R2A.CH' BIND R2A.CV 1 EQ 'R2A.CD' BIND 1 R2A.CH R2A.CV 3 MUL 1 ADD R2A.CH FLOOR R2A.CH EQ SELECT R2A.CD SELECT R2A.CA 1 GET 0 1 R2A.CD SELECT ADD 2 COLLECT
members.note: Collatz fold step: [ value steps ] and an ignored element -> next [ value steps ], standing still once value is 1

members.name: Z3C.COLSTEP
members.body: 'EL' BIND 'AC' BIND AC 0 GET 'CX' BIND AC 1 GET 'CS' BIND CX 1 EQ 'DN' BIND CX 2 DIV FLOOR 'HF' BIND HF 2 MUL CX EQ 'EV' BIND HF CX 3 MUL 1 ADD EV SELECT 'NV' BIND CX NV DN SELECT 'NX' BIND CS CS 1 ADD DN SELECT 'NS' BIND NX NS 2 COLLECT
members.note: FOLD step on [x steps] applying one Collatz move unless x is already 1.

members.name: R2B.RLE
members.body: 'R2B.RV' BIND R2B.RV R2B.RV R2B.RUNMASK R2B.KEEP 0 R2B.RV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE R2B.RV R2B.RUNMASK R2B.KEEP 'R2B.RS' BIND R2B.RS 1 DROP R2B.RV LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT R2B.RS SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
members.note: Vector of numbers -> Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per run of equal adjacent values.

members.name: R2D.RLE
members.body: 'R2D.RV' BIND R2D.RV R2D.STARTS 'R2D.RM' BIND R2D.RM R2D.WHERE 'R2D.RS' BIND R2D.RV R2D.RM R2D.KEEP R2D.RS 1 DROP R2D.RV LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT R2D.RS SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
members.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent values

members.name: R2C.RUNSTARTS
members.body: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP 'RC' BIND RV -1 DROP 'RP' BIND [ TRUE ] RC RP LT NOT RP RC LT NOT AND NOT CONCAT 'RS' BIND 0 RV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'XI' BIND RS XI GET ] FILTER
members.note: Vector -> indices where a new run of equal adjacent values starts (index 0 always starts a run)

members.name: S0A.STARTS
members.body: 'SV' BIND 0 SV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 'SI' BIND SV SV SI 1 SUB GET SUB 'SD' BIND SI -1 SD SD MUL 0 GT 0 TRUE PUT SELECT [ -1 GT ] FILTER
members.note: numeric vector -> indices where a run of equal adjacent values starts

members.name: R2D.PRIMES
members.body: 1 'R2D.PN' BIND R2D.PN RANGE [ R2D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: positive integer n -> ascending Vector of the primes <= n (empty when none)

members.name: S0A.PRIMES
members.body: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ S0A.ISPRIME ] FILTER
members.note: positive integer n -> primes <= n ascending

members.name: R2D.COLLATZ
members.body: 'R2D.CN' BIND 1 200 RANGE R2D.CN 0 2 COLLECT [ 'R2D.CI' BIND [ 'R2D.CC' 'R2D.CS' ] BIND 1 R2D.CC 2 DIV R2D.CC 3 MUL 1 ADD R2D.CC 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL R2D.CC EQ SELECT R2D.CC 1 EQ SELECT R2D.CS 1 ADD R2D.CS R2D.CC 1 EQ NOT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
members.note: positive integer -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1 (runs 200 fixed steps, enough for every n below about 1000)

members.name: E2D.COLLATZ
members.body: 'N' BIND 0 199 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ 'I' BIND [ 'C' 'K' ] BIND C 2 DIV 'H' BIND H FLOOR H EQ 'E' BIND H 3 C MUL 1 ADD E SELECT 'NX' BIND C K 2 COLLECT NX K 1 ADD 2 COLLECT C 1 EQ SELECT ] FOLD 1 GET
members.note: positive integer -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1 (200 iterations of the rule, enough for n up to several thousand)

members.name: R2D.BALANCED-PREFIX
members.body: R1D.USTACKS [ '#' EQ ] MAP R2D.WHERE -1 GET
members.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is)

members.name: E0D.BALANCED-PREFIX
members.body: CHARS [ [ '#' ] TRUE ] [ E0D.BSTEP ] SCAN [ E0D.BOK ] MAP 'T' BIND T E0D.IOTA 1 ADD T E0D.MASK 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: bracket String -> length of the longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty one)

members.name: R3A.RUNIDS
members.body: 'R3A.IV' BIND R3A.IV R3A.IV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'R3A.IE' BIND 'R3A.IC' BIND R3A.IE R3A.IC 1 GET R3A.IC 1 GET 1 ADD R3A.IC 0 GET R3A.IE EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
members.note: non-empty Vector -> same-length Vector of run ids (0,0,1,...) that step up whenever the value changes from its left neighbour

members.name: R3B.STARTS
members.body: 'SV' BIND SV SV R3B.PREV SUB [ 0 EQ NOT ] MAP 'SM' BIND 0 SV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE -1 SM SELECT [ -1 EQ NOT ] FILTER
members.note: Number Vector (1+ elements) -> ascending indices where a run of equal adjacent values starts.

members.name: R3A.MAJORITY
members.body: 'R3A.MV' BIND R3A.MV LENGTH 'R3A.MN' BIND R3A.MV TALLY 'R3A.MT' BIND R3A.MT KEYS [ 'R3A.MK' BIND R3A.MT R3A.MK GET 2 MUL R3A.MN GT ] FILTER 0 GET
members.note: Vector -> the value occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL

members.name: U2D.MAJORITY
members.body: 'MV' BIND MV TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS [ 'MK' BIND MT MK GET 2 MUL MV LENGTH GT ] FILTER 0 GET
members.note: V -> the value occurring in more than half of the positions, or NIL when none does

members.name: R3D.PAIRS
members.body: 'R3D.PV' BIND R3D.PV -1 DROP R3D.PV 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP
members.note: Vector -> Vector one shorter of adjacent pairs [ previous current ]

members.name: E0D.ADJ
members.body: 'V' BIND V -1 DROP V 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP
members.note: vector (n>=1) -> n-1 adjacent pairs [ v[i] v[i+1] ]

members.name: R3D.DIVISORS
members.body: 'R3D.DN' BIND 1 R3D.DN RANGE [ R3D.DN DIV RATIO 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

members.name: Z3C.DIVISORS
members.body: 'DK' BIND 1 DK RANGE [ DK DIV RATIO 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Ascending positive divisors of a positive integer (d divides k iff d/k has numerator 1).

members.name: R3D.ISPRIME
members.body: R3D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
members.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it is prime

members.name: Z3C.ISPRIME
members.body: Z3C.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
members.note: TRUE when a positive integer has exactly two divisors.

members.name: E0D.RLE
members.body: 'V' BIND V E0D.DEDUPE V E0D.RUNLENS 2 COLLECT ZIP
members.note: vector (n>=1) -> run-length encoding as [ [ value count ] ... ]

members.name: S0D.RLE
members.body: 'V' BIND V S0D.STARTS 'S' BIND V S GET S 1 DROP V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT S SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
members.note: run-length encoding: Vector of [ value count ] pairs

members.name: E0D.BINARY
members.body: 'N' BIND 5 0 RANGE [ 'P' BIND N 2 P POW DIV FLOOR 2 E0D.MOD STR ] MAP JOIN 'S' BIND S CHARS S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
members.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 digits as a String without leading zeros

members.name: E1D.BINARY
members.body: 'E1D.N' BIND 5 0 RANGE [ 'E1D.K' BIND E1D.N 2 E1D.K POW DIV FLOOR 'E1D.Q' BIND E1D.Q E1D.Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB ] MAP STR JOIN 'E1D.S' BIND E1D.S CHARS E1D.S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
members.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 digits as a String without leading zeros

members.name: E0D.COLLATZ
members.body: 'N' BIND 1 130 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND [ 'C' 'S' ] BIND C 1 EQ 'D' BIND C C 2 DIV C 3 MUL 1 ADD C 2 E0D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT D SELECT S S 1 ADD D SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
members.note: positive integer (steps <= 130) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

members.name: E1D.COLLATZ
members.body: 'E1D.N' BIND 1 130 RANGE E1D.N 0 2 COLLECT [ 'E1D.I' BIND E1D.CSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
members.note: positive integer (up to about 60) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1 (130 CSTEP iterations)

members.name: E1D.CSTEP
members.body: [ 'E1D.C' 'E1D.S' ] BIND E1D.C 2 DIV FLOOR 'E1D.H' BIND E1D.C E1D.S 2 COLLECT E1D.H E1D.C 3 MUL 1 ADD E1D.C E1D.H 2 MUL SUB 0 EQ SELECT E1D.S 1 ADD 2 COLLECT E1D.C 1 EQ SELECT
members.note: [ current steps ] -> one Collatz step: [ next steps+1 ], or unchanged when current is 1

members.name: U3D.CSTEP
members.body: [ 'U3D.CC' 'U3D.CK' ] BIND U3D.CC U3D.CC 2 DIV U3D.CC 3 MUL 1 ADD U3D.CC 2 U3D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT U3D.CC 1 EQ SELECT U3D.CK U3D.CK 1 ADD U3D.CC 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT
members.note: [ current steps ] -> one Collatz step: [ next steps+1 ], unchanged once current is 1

members.name: Z1C.DELTA
members.body: 'C' BIND 1 -1 C ')' EQ NOT C ']' EQ NOT AND SELECT
members.note: Maps one bracket character to +1 when it opens a bracket and -1 when it closes one.

members.name: Z2A.BV
members.body: 'Z2A.BC' BIND -1 1 Z2A.BC ']' EQ SELECT
members.note: Character ']' -> -1, anything else -> 1

members.name: Z3D.LONGEST1
members.body: 0 [ 'Z3D.LE' BIND Z3D.LE MUL Z3D.LE ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: 0/1 vector -> length of the longest run of 1s (0 for none)

members.name: U1B.RUNLEN
members.body: 0 [ 'RLE' BIND 1 ADD RLE MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: Vector of 0/1 flags -> length of the longest stretch of consecutive 1s (0 if none)

members.name: S0A.BINARY
members.body: 'BN' BIND 2 0 10 RANGE POW [ BN 1 ADD LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 SUB 0 RANGE 'BE' BIND BN 2 BE POW DIV FLOOR 2 S0A.MOD STR JOIN
members.note: positive integer (< 2048) -> base-2 String without leading zeros

members.name: U2D.BINARY
members.body: 'BN' BIND 0 5 RANGE [ 'BK' BIND 2 BK POW BN GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 SUB 0 RANGE [ 'BJ' BIND BN 2 BJ POW DIV FLOOR 'BQ' BIND BQ BQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB ] MAP STR JOIN
members.note: integer 1..63 -> its base-2 String of '0'/'1' without leading zeros
